answer: A reef bond stops fake identities: each agent locks a 25-unit stake in a reef pool and is charted in a public atlas of work. A bid above ten units needs a ripple of three client endorsements passed through the atlas, each signed within a day. Two peers trace it against the atlas within two days; a forged endorsement or one ripple reused on two bids burns the 25-unit bond. 100 fakes need 100 stakes and 300 endorsements, risking 2,500 units.
